text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Nicolas Bwakira, Southern Africa director for the United Nations High Commission for Refugees, on Tuesday presented a $38 million funding proposal for the resettlement of Angolan refugees to the Angolan Prime Minister Franca Van-Dunem.
- The Angolan Democratic Party for Progress and Alliance will hold its first party conference at the end of March, a party representative announced on Tuesday.
